name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: ZCode session-level token rate monitor — the instant tok/s of the just-finished turn is shown automatically when each reply ends; with a real-time dashboard, /tps command and MCP tools, plus optional service-TPS monitoring via a real metrics endpoint or demo data.

description_i18n.en: ZCode session-level token rate monitor — the instant tok/s of the just-finished turn is shown automatically when each reply ends; with a real-time dashboard, /tps command and MCP tools, plus optional service-TPS monitoring via a real metrics endpoint or demo data.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 会话级 Token 速率监控插件 —— 每轮回复结束的瞬间自动显示本轮即时 tok/s；附实时监控大屏、/tps 命令与 MCP 工具，可选业务 TPS 监控（真实指标接口或演示数据）。

metrics_url.title: Metrics URL
metrics_url.description: HTTP 接口地址，返回包含 tps/qps 字段的 JSON；留空则使用演示数据。
